groups.evidence: Dark blue bars visible at top of beam section in detail view, extending over support regions at both ends. Annotation '2-Y25' points to these bars. Bars appear shorter than full span, concentrated at support zones.
Dark blue bars visible at bottom of beam section running full length. Annotation '2L-Y12@100C/C' indicates 2 longitudinal Y12 bars. These appear to span the entire beam length.

Green vertical bars visible on both side faces of beam in both context and detail views. These appear to be side face bars running full span, part of the '2L-Y12@100C/C' specification indicating longitudinal placement.

stirrups.evidence: Annotation '2L-Y12@100C/C' visible in detail view. The 'L' designation and spacing '@100C/C' indicates links/stirrups at 100mm centers. Green outline visible in cross-section suggests closed stirrup configuration.

ambiguities: The '2L-Y12@100C/C' annotation may refer to both longitudinal bottom bars and stirrups/links. Interpretation assumes 'L' indicates links (stirrups) with 2 legs, but could also mean longitudinal bars.
The exact length and termination points of the 2-Y25 top bars are not clearly visible in the provided views.
